author: National Geographic
description:
Join Will Smith and National Geographic on an unforgettable journey across all seven continents in only 100 days. Inspired by his mentor, Dr. Allen Counter, Will Smith takes off on the journey his mentor always wished for him to undertake. From the icebergs of the Pacific to Amazon Rainforest, to the mountains of the Himalayas, Will Smith undergoes the greatest creative enjoyment he has ever had.
